name: antigravity-auto-accept
description: Zero-friction auto-acceptance and smart auto-close for AI agent edits, diffs, and terminal commands in Google Antigravity. Automatically sweeps and closes agent-opened file tabs while protecting user files and plan reviews.

autoAcceptAgent.showStatusBarItem.description: Show the AutoAccept indicator in the status bar.

autoAcceptAgent.enableCommandPolling.description: Enable automatic polling of accept/approve commands.

autoAcceptAgent.pollIntervalMs.description: Interval in milliseconds between polling cycles. Lower = faster auto-acceptance but more CPU. Default: 800ms.

autoAcceptAgent.autoConfigureSettings.description: Automatically configure VS Code/Antigravity settings to skip routine command approval prompts.

autoAcceptAgent.interceptNotifications.description: Automatically accept primary actions on approval notifications (Run, Allow, Yes).

autoAcceptAgent.enableCDP.description: Enable optional CDP fallback to click approval buttons directly in webviews when command polling cannot reach them. Default: false.

autoAcceptAgent.customButtonTexts.description: Additional button text labels to auto-click in the agent UI.

autoAcceptAgent.blockedCommands.description: Commands that will never be auto-accepted.

autoAcceptAgent.checkForUpdates.description: Periodically check for extension updates from internal Forgejo Git server.

autoAcceptAgent.autoUpdate.description: Automatically download and install updates from internal Forgejo server when available.

autoAcceptAgent.updateServerUrl.description: Internal Forgejo server URL for extension updates.

autoAcceptAgent.autoCloseAcceptedEditors.description: Automatically close editor tabs opened by AI agents after changes are accepted and saved. User-opened tabs and pinned tabs remain untouched.

autoAcceptAgent.autoCloseDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before closing an auto-accepted editor tab to allow background saves to settle.
